Name: Purchasable Machines
Author: emuserv1
Description:
Make all base craft-able [i]Machines[/i], also purchasable.
This mod is fully configurable, thanks to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿
This mod accepts i18n translations. I have personally done only English as of now, but if I receive enough requests (or someone wants to contribute) I will add other languages.

[size=5][u][b]Configuration Options[/b][/u][/size]
[size=3][u]Purchase location[/u][/size]
Most vanilla shops are available[list]
[*]Adventurer's Guild
[*]Clint's blacksmith shop
[*]Dwarf's shop
[*]Harvey's clinic
[*]Joja Mart
[*]Marnie's ranch
[*]Pierre's general store
[*]Robin's carpenter shop
[*]Stardrop Saloon
[*]Traveling Cart
[*]Willy's fish shop
[/list]
[size=3][u]Availability[/u] (when it becomes available on the Shop)[/size]
[list][*]Never
[*]Day 1
[*]Year 2
[*]Recipe Discovered
[*]Community Center Completed
[/list]
[size=3][u]Price[/u][/size]
You can configure the cost of purchasing each machine. If you feel like cheating, set it to 0...

[size=3][u]Stock[/u][/size]
You can configure how many of each machine you can purchase in a day.
